universe_and_method: Secondary report of Locomotiva/QuestionPro survey; 1,557 adults 18+ nationwide; fieldwork 2026-02-25 to 2026-03-13; Easter intent context
observed_fact: 90% reported intent to buy Easter-related chocolate; 61% named price as the main choice factor, followed by ingredient quality 53%, size 44%, known brand 43%, variety 40%; 69% considered Easter eggs unfairly priced versus bars of equal weight
represents: Reported stated intent and stated choice criteria in a seasonal survey
does_not_represent: Actual purchases, continuous-year category demand, causality, brand switching, current October behavior
signal_candidate: Price/value scrutiny with continued seasonal participation; format/value alternatives merit follow-up
limitations: Survey is seasonal and self-reported; source reports survey results, not observed transactions. Not independent from the survey itself.

universe_and_method: Secondary report of AtlasIntel survey; 2,154 respondents nationwide; fieldwork 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-30; Easter consumption plans
observed_fact: 54.7% said they would celebrate Easter with chocolate bars; 44.7% industrial eggs; 34.2% artisanal eggs; 45.3% bonbons
represents: Reported planned format choices in a separate Easter survey
does_not_represent: Actual purchases, annual category trend, exact market shares, causal substitution
signal_candidate: Non-egg formats may be meaningful alternatives during high-price seasonal occasions
limitations: Different survey from CAP-20261015-001; still seasonal, self-reported and not transaction data. Percentages may overlap because respondents could select multiple formats.

universe_and_method: FGV IBRE Easter basket price release; year-over-year basket changes and four-year cumulative comparison
observed_fact: The Easter basket average fell 6.77% in 2025 and 5.73% in 2026 year over year, while chocolates and bonbons remained on a continuous upward price trajectory over the four-year period
represents: Industry/consumer price context with divergent aggregate and item-level movement
does_not_represent: Retailer-level shelf prices, shopper intent, exact chocolate SKU movements, current October prices
signal_candidate: Category price pressure may differ from the headline Easter basket; inspect item-level and format-level prices
limitations: Aggregate Easter basket declines do not mean chocolate itself became cheaper; this is not a shopper-behavior measure.

universe_and_method: Secondary report of Cielo broad retail index; September 2026 versus September 2025
observed_fact: Real retail sales fell 3.9% year over year in September 2026; e-commerce sales grew 5.1% nominally while physical retail fell 0.1% nominally
represents: Macro retail context that may shape value-seeking and channel mix
does_not_represent: Chocolate-specific demand, chocolate e-commerce performance, causal explanation of category movement
signal_candidate: Current consumption backdrop is pressured; check whether chocolate shows the same or different pattern
independence_group: Cielo retail index reported by UOL
limitations: All-retail data, not chocolate-specific; online growth is nominal while overall headline is real, so these figures are not directly comparable.

universe_and_method: ETENE sector note on cocoa production, grinding and global supply; published June 2026
observed_fact: The note attributes the 2025 cocoa price decline to weaker demand alongside higher production after a historic price spike; it flags 2026 uncertainty due to potential El Niño impacts
represents: Commodity/supply context relevant to cost and price transmission hypotheses
does_not_represent: Shopper behavior, retail prices, chocolate sales, brand pricing decisions
signal_candidate: Input-market changes are a plausible context variable but must be tested against retail price observations
independence_group: Banco do Nordeste ETENE sector note
limitations: Supply-side evidence only; no direct shopper or SKU-level price observations.

universe_and_method: Trade publication homepage/article dated 2026-10-09; industry coverage, not primary shopper data
observed_fact: The publication reports 25.3% growth in cocoa reception for crop 2025/26 and says grinding/export derivatives rebounded in Q3 while Jan-Sep processing remained 18.5% below 2023
does_not_represent: Shopper demand, retail sales, brand pricing or causal consumer response
signal_candidate: Supply-chain indicators are mixed and should remain a separate signal family
limitations: Trade-media report; underlying data source/methodology should be checked before quantifying an external-facing claim.

universe_and_method: Newsroom field visit to nine supermarkets plus a municipal market and chocolate shops; Easter 2026 price snapshots
observed_fact: The report observed small Easter eggs around R$20–R$40, known-brand eggs from roughly R$50 and bars around R$5.99 to R$13 for 145g in the visited outlets
represents: Historical, local, seasonal price examples from a limited physical-store sample
does_not_represent: National average price, current October prices, representative retail time series or causal shopper substitution
signal_candidate: Format/price comparisons are worth measuring directly per 100g across stores and dates
limitations: April Easter snapshots from a limited set of outlets; cannot be used as current price or longitudinal series.

universe_and_method: Public product detail for Lacta milk chocolate 80g; site methodology says daily automated collection from supermarket online stores and product-level matching
observed_fact: Page reports 280 observations from 211 markets in 177 identified cities between 2026-04-01 and 2026-09-26; SP sample 149 observations from 96 markets in 78 cities; SP mean R$8.89 and +1.1% between August and September monthly means
represents: Secondary retail price time-series context for one named 80g product
does_not_represent: Complete national retail, sales weighting, physical shelf prices, shopper behavior, causal price drivers
signal_candidate: A public retail source provides a historical comparison path; evaluate repeated SKU price changes and geographic dispersion
independence_group: CustoPorPrato collection; source pages underlying data are supermarket sites
limitations: Non-probability online-store sample; coverage and dates vary; same retailer network may appear in multiple cities; not official inflation index. Source page displays summary but raw underlying rows were not exported.
